info.description:
Estimate US import duties by HTS code and country of origin, including Section 301, Section 232 and other Chapter 99 tariffs, plus MPF and HMF.

Docs: https://tariff.synnaxstudio.com/docs
Try it without code: https://tariff.synnaxstudio.com/calculator

Auth: Business Plan API key in the X-API-Key header (set the api_key collection variable). Business Plan includes 2,500 calls per monthly billing cycle.

Always check `isIncomplete` in every calculate response: when required fields (e.g. metal composition) are missing, duties are skipped and totalDuty is understated.
info.name: Tariff Calculator API

request.description: Calculate import duty for one shipment. Example from the docs: boys' wool overcoat (HS 6201201120) from Vietnam, $15,000, ocean freight, 100 KG.
Section 232 example from the docs: steel article (HS 7326901000) from Ukraine, $10,000, 50% steel poured in Ukraine. Without additionalFields, Section 232 duties are skipped and isIncomplete is true.

item.name: Tariff info for an HS code

request.description: Returns tariff metadata for an HS code, including metalProfiles (which Section 232 fields the code needs) and userSelectionCandidates (provisions only you can confirm; send a confirmed code in additionalFields.CHOSEN_HTS_CODES as true).
